task: P19 'Island, made playable' — Island is declared (2, "Island") in MapCatalog and carries none of the sixteen netcode scripts, so a client joining a room on map 2 loads a world with no snapshots adopted, no remote players, no score and no capture replication, while ClientFlowBootstrap reports the load a success. Author both netcode roots into the scene, measure and author a LevelBounds volume, add a per-MAP authoring gate driven from MapCatalog rather than from the scenes that already look like maps, and correct a false remark about spawn-point ownership.
scoutSummary: Project type: Unity 6000.3 game (Ironfront) plus eight .NET class libraries and tool projects; Ironfront.sln. | Relevant modules: Ironfront_Reborn/Assets/Scenes (Island.unity, Dustbowl.unity), Assets/Scripts/Net/{Server,Client,Shared}, Ironfront.Net.Configuration/MapCatalog.cs, tools/ClientWiringGate, tools/run-lane-b.ps1. | Conventions: authoring gates read force-text YAML and never resolve types (decision D21: no licensed Editor in CI); exit 0 clean / 1 found something / 2 could not tell, and 'could not tell' must never read as a pass; every detector is a pure function over a parsed index so its RED path is reachable from a fixture; commit subjects are conventional with a lower-case description under 72 chars and a scope from a fixed list. | Docs and plans read: plans/phases/phase-p19-island.md, plans/reports/p18-scoreboard.md (for the accepted screenshot-evidence method), rules/pinned-baseline-test-companion.md, rules/green-that-proves-nothing.md. | Affected contracts: MatchController._capturePoints array order IS the wire capture-point index; ProjectileCatalogInstaller._prefabsByKind and NetClientProjectilePresenter._prefabsByKind are both indexed by ProjectileKind and neither side learns the other's order; Quantize.POS_MIN -1024 / POS_MAX 3072 bounds every serialized position.
acceptanceCriteria: 1 the re-serialization is its own commit
2 two clients join Island and see each other move, screenshot from both
3 capture points change hands and the flag renders, on both clients
4 the score moves and the bar tracks it
5 a match reaches a winner, stating whether by margin or by elimination
6 'opening ownership adopted: 2 of 5' appears and the 'no capture point authored to either team' error does not
7 the installer's and the presenter's _prefabsByKind hold the same guids in the same order, element by element
8 the authored LevelBounds box contains the measured playable extents and fits -1024..3072 m, both numbers stated
9 the per-scene gate was observed RED against Island before authoring, is green after, and one mutation confirms it can still fail
10 PinnedSpawnPointDirectory's remark states the measured distribution
11 Island can host as well as join: NetRoleBootstrap selects the server role and a match runs
touchpoints: tools/ClientWiringGate/** -- the new per-map authoring check and its registration
Ironfront.Net.Replication.Tests/AssetWiringGateTests.cs -- the detector-class list and two fixtures
tools/run-lane-b.ps1 -- a -Scene parameter, validated against MapCatalog
publicContracts: MatchController._capturePoints array ORDER is the wire capture-point index; SceneCapturePoints.Bind falls back to FindObjectsOfType sorted by name when it is empty
ProjectileCatalogInstaller._prefabsByKind and NetClientProjectilePresenter._prefabsByKind are both indexed by ProjectileKind and neither side learns the other's order
Quantize.POS_MIN -1024f / POS_MAX 3072f bounds every serialized position; a body outside it clamps silently
MapCatalog.All is the map table both the client's scene resolution and, from now on, the authoring gate read
AssetGateRunner.Checks is the registered check list; a detector absent from it runs on nobody's machine
blastRadius: One scene gains two netcode roots plus a Controllers/Level Bounds object; no existing object in it was modified except by Unity's own re-serialization.
One new authoring check runs on every CI build over every scene and prefab; it can only add findings, never remove them.

No shipped component changed behaviour: the only runtime-visible edit is an exception message string in a diagnostics-only class that nothing asserts on. Quantize.cs:48-49, POS_MIN -1024f, POS_MAX 3072f
Dustbowl was opened additively during authoring and closed WITHOUT saving; git reports it unmodified.
